<!-- pr-reviewer: 5dfac127d422aee4d866ee32ac8ead926c72e97b -->
**Ready for the maintainer to merge.**

Reviewed head 5dfac12 (2 commits) against current main (010bca6), trial-merged locally with no conflicts.

### What looks good
- The change only adds refusals: `borne_out` returns false when the folded area of wide latitude classes passes `FOLD_SHARE` (`crates/motion/src/multiaxis/axis_point.rs`, `borne_out` and `folded`). It cannot make a previously refused fit trusted, so the failure direction is the safe one.
- The #237 case is pinned in `crates/motion/src/multiaxis/axis_wide_tests.rs` (`a_fine_ball_with_a_flat_rod_through_it_never_reads_a_cross_axis`, 120x60 / 144x72 / 180x90 with three rods, plus the tilted rod test). The helper accepts only a refusal or the rod's own axis.
- I also probed polygonal rods (triangle, square, pentagon, hexagon, octagon, 12-gon, r5, 100 long) through a 120x60 ball, outside the PR's tests. Every one was refused by name ("every axis fits this model equally..."). The PR's note that a hex is not caught by the fold test does not show up as a trusted axis in this geometry. The probe was local only and reverted.
- No `unwrap`/`expect`/`panic` in `src`. `axis_point.rs` is 384 lines, under the ~400 budget.
- Commit subjects are conventional and the body ends `Fixes #237`, with a `Changelog:` line.

### Local results (trial merge with main)
| Suite | Result |
|---|---|
| `camcraft-motion --lib -- axis` | 56 passed, 0 failed (includes the #237 pins) |
| app `drilling_cross*` (7 binaries: drilling_cross, _box, _holder, _part, _rapids, _spindle, _stock) | all pass (holder 2, part 3, cross 9, box 7, rapids 2, spindle 7, stock 8) |
| app `lathe_*` (lathe_cross_drill, lathe_field_sim, lathe_post, lathe_post_refusals, lathe_spindle_fit, lathe_spindle_keyed, lathe_spindle_law) | all pass |
| app `turning*` (10 binaries) | all pass |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-app --lib -- -D warnings` | clean |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-motion --all-targets -- -D warnings` | clean |

Full run: 26 app binaries, 0 failures.

### Requested before merge
None.

### Questions / notes (not blocking)
1. Main does not build `crates/app/tests/drilling_cross_holder.rs` and `drilling_cross_part.rs` (missing `coolant` in `Operation`, `crates/app/src/schema.rs:176`). Same as the other PRs in this batch. To run them I added `coolant: Default::default()` locally in the review worktree and reverted it afterwards. The maintainer should fix this on main separately.
2. `folded` casts `(l / LAT_BIN).floor() as i64` (`axis_point.rs`). The input is finite-filtered, and Rust's `as` saturates, so this is defined, but a `checked`/`clamp` before the cast would match the Prime Directive wording more closely. Not blocking.
3. The fail-closed side effect the PR documents (a square section inside a dome is refused) is accepted; I agree that is the safe side.
4. The PR's `RECOMMENDED.md` entry is an append. Main has moved that file too; on merge, keep both sides.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
